title: Holistic Parallel Supervision for Expressive Speech to Speech Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expressiveness is central to speech-to-speech translation (S2ST), yet existing datasets rarely align source and target speech jointly in content, prosody, timing, and speaker identity. Consequently, current systems often rely on indirect conditioning or transfer mechanisms. To obtain this supervision, we introduce a training-data construction strategy that combines professional dubbing, which provides human-performed correspondence in content, prosody, and timing, with multilingual voice conversion to reduce speaker mismatch. We evaluate this supervision using existing expressive S2ST systems and DirectS2ST, an end-to-end method developed in this work that predicts the complete target-speech representation directly from source speech. Experiments on English-German and English-Spanish show that holistic parallel supervision improves expressive realization across all evaluated systems. translated_title: 面向富有表现力的语音到语音翻译的整体并行监督
translated_abstract: 表现力是语音到语音翻译（S2ST）的核心，然而现有数据集很少能在内容、韵律、时序和说话人身份方面对源语音和目标语音进行联合对齐。因此，当前系统通常依赖间接的条件控制或迁移机制。为获得这种监督信号，我们提出了一种训练数据构建策略，将专业配音（在内容、韵律和时序上提供人工完成的对应关系）与多语言语音转换相结合，以减少说话人身份的不匹配。我们使用现有的表现性S2ST系统以及本文开发的端到端方法DirectS2ST来评估这种监督，该方法直接从源语音预测完整的目标语音表示。在英-德和英-西语言对上的实验表明，整体并行监督在所有被评估系统中均改善了表现力的实现，其中DirectS2ST在内容和韵律方面取得了最大的提升。
tldr: 本文提出结合专业配音与多语言语音转换的整体并行监督训练数据构建策略，并开发了直接从源语音预测完整目标语音表示的端到端DirectS2ST系统，显著提升了语音到语音翻译的表现力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a holistic parallel supervision strategy combining professional dubbing with multilingual voice conversion, and develops DirectS2ST, an end-to-end system that directly predicts complete target-speech representations, significantly improving expressiveness in speech-to-speech translation.
